data.name: WanTextToVideoApi
data.description: Generates a video based on a text prompt.

input_details.name: prompt
input_details.tooltip: Prompt describing the elements and visual features. Supports English and Chinese.

input_details.name: negative_prompt
input_details.tooltip: Negative prompt describing what to avoid.

input_details.name: duration
input_details.tooltip: A 15-second duration is available only for the Wan 2.6 model.

input_details.name: audio
input_details.tooltip: Audio must contain a clear, loud voice, without extraneous noise or background music.

input_details.name: generate_audio
input_details.tooltip: If no audio input is provided, generate audio automatically.

input_details.name: prompt_extend
input_details.tooltip: Whether to enhance the prompt with AI assistance.

input_details.name: watermark
input_details.tooltip: Whether to add an AI-generated watermark to the result.

input_details.name: shot_type
input_details.tooltip: Specifies the shot type for the generated video, that is, whether the video is a single continuous shot or multiple shots with cuts. This parameter takes effect only when prompt_extend is True.
